scope: Offline fake transports first; no inference authorization

checks.name: Default offline mode
checks.acceptance: Replace all socket/HTTP entry points with failing spies; constructing and running fake fixtures performs zero network calls.

checks.name: Source gaps
checks.acceptance: Paraphrased, mixed, company and compliance requests without eligible evidence launch no worker and make zero provider calls; public output is fixed.

checks.name: Public output isolation
checks.acceptance: Inject distinct sentinels into successful replies, malformed JSON, unknown fields/statuses, exceptions, paths and logs; no sentinel or review_draft field appears in public bytes.

checks.name: Native stdout/stderr
checks.acceptance: A fake worker uses print, logging and os.write on both descriptors; capture separately, reject contaminated protocol, never inherit/forward to public output.

checks.name: Bounds and parser
checks.acceptance: Oversized input/stdout/stderr, duplicate JSON keys, multiple replies, trailing bytes, missing fields and invalid types fail closed within configured memory/time limits.

checks.name: Streaming and partial failure
checks.acceptance: Fake partial chunks, truncated output, tool calls, missing terminal completion and error after content yield no stored/viewable draft and no public tokens.

checks.name: Cancellation
checks.acceptance: Cancel while fake worker is blocked; join/terminate worker, discard partial output, latch batch stopped; second request cannot run until separate operator reset/new batch.

checks.name: Deadline
checks.acceptance: Fake silent reads, slow endless chunks and simulated overdue completion hit controller deadline independent of reads; late response is discarded and batch stops.

checks.name: Concurrency
checks.acceptance: Two simultaneous submissions produce at most one active worker/provider call; other request fails with fixed busy status and is not queued.

checks.name: Reviewer boundary
checks.acceptance: Missing/wrong/author-only authorization never invokes private serialization; no public command/path reaches view or debug state; private drafts remain inert data.

checks.name: Attestation races
checks.acceptance: Revoke, expire or supersede evidence during fake generation; result never enters private viewing; registry substitution, legacy and replay regressions remain passing.

checks.name: Citation integrity
checks.acceptance: Malformed/missing/fabricated IDs reject; valid IDs on a false claim do not mark it factual or release it; adapter does not repair/invent source IDs.

checks.name: Manifest and provider configuration
checks.acceptance: Changed hash/count/model/endpoint/tools/options fails before launch; caller/source/model text cannot select URL, shell command, credentials or worker settings.

checks.name: Private artifacts and credentials
checks.acceptance: Worker receives no signing key or reviewer token; public logs contain only fixed events; no raw persistence by default; any later raw export requires verified operator-only access.

checks.name: Preservation and measured results
checks.acceptance: Existing 77 tests and hashes remain valid; save each harness check result separately. Mock latency is not model latency; denied calls are not completed answers.

checks.name: Live approval barrier
checks.acceptance: No fake-mode path enables live transport. All checks PASS and exact tiny manifest/configuration require explicit separate approval before first provider connection.
